summary: Track 16.08 backend (Orientation Engine, Native Video Player, Quiz Engine, Certificate Engine, Secure External Invite Portal, Email Routing v2 notifications, dispatch eligibility) is solid — 40/40 regression tests pass against the live preview backend (26 static + 6 pure async + 8 live e2e: admin auth, 22 module bootstrap, 4-language placeholders, dashboard KPIs, question CRUD, full orientation→quiz→cert flow with audit_hash + cert_number, invite create→open→submit, bad-token 404, admin auth gating). Public routes /transport-invite/:token and /transport-verify/:cnum render correctly with proper Not-Found error states. Sub-nav exposes txnav-orientation. OrientationCenter mounts at /admin/transportation/orientation with all 4 sub-tabs (Dashboard, Modules, Assignments, Certificates) and the correct testids (tx-orientation-center, tx-orientation-subtabs). HOWEVER one CRITICAL frontend integration bug breaks every admin orientation data load.

integration_issues.flow: Admin Orientation Center (Dashboard / Modules / Module-detail / Assignments / Certificates) AND Carrier Invite Portal AND Certificate Verify AND MasciVideoPlayer heartbeat
integration_issues.issue: All 13 axios calls in the new Track 16.08 frontend files pass paths beginning with '/api/' to the shared axios `api` client whose baseURL is already `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api`. axios concatenates baseURL+url => the network request goes to '/api/api/admin/transportation/orientation/...' which the FastAPI router does not match → backend returns 404 → every Orientation Center sub-tab renders 'unavailable · Request failed with status code 404'. Verified by curl: GET /api/api/admin/transportation/orientation/dashboard => 404, while the same path WITHOUT the extra /api works fine (40/40 pytest e2e tests prove the backend). All other transportation pages (e.g. _widgets.jsx line 245 uses '/admin/transportation/rate-schedules' — NO leading /api) follow the correct convention.
integration_issues.fix: Strip the leading '/api' from every api.{get,post,patch} URL in the four files above. Example: api.get('/api/admin/transportation/orientation/dashboard', ...) → api.get('/admin/transportation/orientation/dashboard', ...). The public CertificateVerify page and bad-token invite portal appear to 'work' in the smoke test only because they happen to be testing 404 paths anyway — but valid tokens / valid cert numbers will ALSO fail until this is fixed.

Remove the leading '/api' from all 13 axios call sites — the shared `api` client baseURL already injects /api. Once fixed: re-run UI smoke to confirm Orientation Dashboard tiles render, Modules tab lists 21 modules, and Module Detail loads questions/placeholders.
critical_code_review_comments: All 13 api.* calls in the new Track 16.08 frontend files redundantly add '/api/' to paths even though the shared axios client (frontend/src/lib/api.js L16-19) sets baseURL = `${BACKEND_URL}/api`. Every other transportation file (e.g. _widgets.jsx, _shared.jsx, _views.jsx) follows the correct convention of NOT prefixing /api. This is a copy-paste regression from a different fetch pattern.

Frontend swallows the 404 with a generic '<X> unavailable' card — consider distinguishing 404 (no data yet) from 4xx integration errors so future regressions surface louder. Currently the UI looks 'empty' rather than 'broken'.

MasciVideoPlayer heartbeat (components/transportation/MasciVideoPlayer.jsx L41) has the same /api/api bug — once a real orientation flow runs with a published sky_asset_id, no-skip enforcement will silently fail to advance because every heartbeat returns 404.

rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE — frontend/src/lib/api.js line 16-19 defines `export const api = axios.create({ baseURL: `${BACKEND_URL}/api` })`. Track 16.08 frontend code (4 files, 13 call sites) was written as if `api` had baseURL = BACKEND_URL only, so every URL was prefixed with '/api/'. axios.combineURLs produces '${BACKEND_URL}/api' + '/api/admin/...' = '${BACKEND_URL}/api/api/admin/...' which the FastAPI ingress correctly 404s. REPRODUCTION: `curl https://safety-audit-mobile-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api/api/admin/transportation/orientation/dashboard` returns 404, while `curl -H 'X-Admin-Token: <admin>' https://.../api/admin/transportation/orientation/dashboard` returns 200 with KPI payload. MITIGATION: search-replace the leading '/api' off the 13 call sites; no backend change needed.
